description: This file defines interfaces, functions, and classes for computing statistical measures (mean, variance, covariance, SSIM) on image channels, including an optimized class for fast calculations.

classes.name: FastStats
classes.description: A class implementing the Stats interface with optimized methods for calculating statistical measures on image channels.

methods.name: ssim
methods.description: Calculates the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) between two regions of image channels using provided Stats object.
